headline: Bitcoin Reclaims 80k After Sliding To 79k
narrative: Bitcoin rose back to 80k from 79k. Ether rose to 2,324 from 2,296 and Solana rose to 101.31 from 99.88. Exchanges recorded a $172.5 million net outflow over 24 hours, meaning more dollar value left trading venues than entered, while bitcoin open interest rose to $2.49 billion from $2.47 billion as new futures positions opened.
author: jordan
